root_cause: The portal receives a pending cross-domain change review but cannot tell whether its corresponding canonical Brain review obligation is open or blocked.
prevention: Only query the Brain obligation derived from the authenticated tenant's current policy and exact prior material change ID
Expose only state and updated time, never actor, raw audit evidence or cross-tenant obligations
A Brain FULFILLED state does not prove CSRD applicability, verified emissions or runtime activation

evidence.outcome: Read-only tenant-projected Brain review state added to data sovereignty snapshot; authenticated customer readback remains separately required
